about: The run's kind is the target list's class (how the vehicle is registered). For the model, a picture's kind is what it shows: these photos, looked at one by one (28 Oct), show the other kind. A panel van listed as a car reads as a van; a hatchback, estate or SUV listed as a van (its van version was the target, its car version the photo) reads as a car. MPVs on a van body (Caravelle, Spacetourer, i800, Independence) read as vans. Pickups stay vans.

build_is_other_kind.van-mini-clubvan: car: the build is an estate car stand-in for a panel-sided Mini (a wrong build, left for the match to find)
